answer_1.outputs: Generated captions, OCR outputs, and responses to visual instructions

answer_2.quote: evaluate SAIL-VL's caption performance on the DetailCaps-4870 benchmark with GPT evaluation. ... For OCR tasks, we compute the ANLS score

answer_3.quote: We feed the candidate captions and ground truth ones to Azure GPT4O API, and ask the model to judge the candidate caption quality based on the precision and recall of visual elements

answer_4.quote: we also task human experts to evaluate the data quality. ... human annotators are given two candidate captions...
answer_4.guideline: Each image is paired with two captions, you should rate them based on the following criteria: • Hallucination: Is there any Entity/Attribute/Relationship described in the caption but NOT present in the image? • Inaccuracy: Is there any Entity/Attribute/Relationship present in the image but incorrectly described? • Omission: Is there any Entity/Attribute/Relationship missing in the caption but clearly visible in the image? • Language Fluency: Does the caption violate standard syntax or use unnatural expressions?
